entities.name: Sadaf Rahimi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sadaf Rahimi is an Afghan boxer. She was the first Afghan female boxer to be invited to the 2012 London Olympics, and the first female boxer on Afghanistan's national boxing team.
